text: My favorite thing to do on Saturdays is play Roblox with my best friend Sam. We usually play a game where you have to run away from a giant piggy. It is kind of scary but really funny when Sam gets caught. After that, we switch to Minecraft. I am building a huge castle made of diamond blocks, and Sam is making a farm for all the cows. When my mom says screen time is over, we go watch Pokemon on TV and pretend we are trainers. I wish I had a real Pikachu!

My big sister Sarah pretended she was a brave **knight** fighting a dragon in the backyard. She ran **straight** at the big bush and yelled, "Take that!" I **thought** she looked silly, but then she got her foot **caught** on a root. She fell right **through** the leaves! Dad laughed and said, "That is **enough** dragon fighting for today, Sarah." We went inside for juice, but Sarah still acted like she saved the whole kingdom.

It’s super hot outside today, so we're going to the pool! I can't wait to jump off the big diving board. My brother says he’s scared, but I told him it’s not that high. Oh man! I almost forgot my goggles. Mom says we have to put on sunscreen first, which is the worst part. Ugh. But then? Cannonball time! Wow! The water is going to feel amazing. I bet I can hold my breath longer than anyone. No way am I getting out until dinner time!

I can't believe what happened at recess today! We were playing kickball, and it was my turn to kick. I hit the ball super hard. Wham! It went right over the fence and into the big muddy puddle in the parking lot. Oh man! Everyone was yelling, "Run! Run!" I made it all the way to home base before the teacher blew the whistle. But now my favorite shoes are totally ruined because I had to go get the ball. My mom is going to be so mad, but it was the best home run ever! No way!

I love Saturdays because my mom lets me play Roblox on my iPad for a long time. My friend Leo called me and said, "Let's play Adopt Me!" so I joined his game. We got a new pet dragon and it was so cool. After that, we switched to Minecraft to build a giant house made of dirt. It looked funny. Then my dad yelled, "Dinner is ready!" so I had to stop. I hope I can watch Spider-Man on TV after I eat my pizza.

My dad told me a cool story about a brave **knight** who lived on a tiny **island**. The knight wanted to catch a dragon, but he only **caught** a really big fish instead! He walked **straight** into the water with his shiny armor on. I **thought** that was super funny because armor is heavy. His **daughter** laughed too and said, "Dad, that is not a dragon!" Then they cooked the fish for dinner. It was yummy **enough** for everyone to eat. I wish I had a sword like him.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast with jam for breakfast. It was yummy. Then I went to school on the bus. We played tag at recess and I ran very fast. My friend Sam fell down, but he was okay. In art class, I painted a big blue picture of a whale. After school, I came home and played with my dog. His name is Spot. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I hope tomorrow is fun too.

I couldn't believe my eyes. No way! There was a huge, fluffy dog sitting right on my bed. It was licking my pillow like a giant ice cream cone. "Hey! Stop that!" I yelled, but I was actually smiling. Mom walked in and laughed. "We're keeping him for the weekend," she said. Wow! I jumped on the bed and hugged him tight. He smelled like wet grass and popcorn. Best surprise ever. We're going to play fetch until it gets dark. I can't wait!

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast with jam for breakfast. It was sunny outside so I went to the park with my mom. I saw a big brown dog playing with a ball. The dog was very fast! We played on the swings for a long time. I can go very high now. After lunch, I drew a picture of a robot. My dad said it looked great. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I hope tomorrow is fun too.

I had a dream about a brave knight on a big island. He was looking for the King’s daughter who got lost in the woods. He rode his horse straight through the dark trees. Suddenly, he saw a scary dragon! But he wasn't scared enough to run away. He caught the dragon with a big net and saved the girl. I thought it was real when I woke up, but I was just in my bed.

My big sister acted like a brave knight in our backyard game. She had a cardboard sword and she ran straight at the big tree. "I will save the island!" she yelled really loud. I threw a soft ball at her but she caught it with one hand. "That is not enough to stop me!" she said. I thought she looked funny in her cape, but it was fun. Then her daughter, my little niece, ran through the grass and hugged her leg.

I love Saturdays because my mom lets me play video games for two hours. First, I turned on Roblox and played a game called Adopt Me with my best friend Sam. I got a neon cat! Then Sam said, "Let's go play Fortnite." We tried to win a match, but we lost. After that, I was tired of games, so I watched a Pokemon show on TV. Ash was fighting a really strong gym leader with his Pikachu. It was so cool when Pikachu used Thunderbolt. I wish I had a Pikachu in real life.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It had lots of butter on it. Then I went to school on the big yellow bus. We learned about frogs in science class. I like frogs because they jump high. At recess, I played tag with my best friend Sam. I ran very fast and nobody caught me. After school, I watched my favorite show on TV. For dinner, we had pizza with cheese. Now I am tired and ready for bed.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It had lots of butter on it. Then I went to school on the big yellow bus. We played tag at recess and I ran very fast. My friend Sam was "it" two times. After school, I came home and played with my dog, Spot. He likes to chase his red ball. For dinner we had pizza. It was so yummy. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I hope tomorrow is fun too.

It was the best day ever because my dad finally took us to the new water park! We’re usually not allowed to go on the big slides, but today he said yes. Wow! I ran straight to the Tornado Tube. It’s huge and scary, but I didn’t care. My little brother tried to follow me, but he’s too short. Oh man! He was so mad. When I splashed down at the bottom, water got everywhere. No way! I want to go again right now. It’s going to be awesome.

My dog Buster is usually a good boy, but today he was totally crazy! We were playing fetch in the park when he saw a squirrel. Whoosh! He took off running so fast I couldn't even grab his leash. "Buster, stop!" I yelled. But he didn't listen. He chased that squirrel right up a giant oak tree and started barking like mad. Oh man! Everyone was staring at us. It was so embarrassing. Finally, my dad had to come over and pick him up. We're definitely keeping him on the leash next time!

One day a brave knight went on a big boat trip. He wanted to find a secret island where a dragon lived. The water was very bumpy, and he almost fell in! But he sailed straight through the big waves. When he got there, he caught a fish for his dinner because he was super hungry. He thought the dragon might be scary, but it was just sleeping. The knight decided he had enough adventure for one day, so he went back home to tell the king's daughter all about it.

I couldn’t believe my eyes when I walked into the kitchen. No way! My dog, Buster, was actually standing on the table. He had his nose right in the birthday cake. "Oh man!" I yelled, but Buster didn't even stop. He just kept licking the blue frosting. It’s supposed to be for my brother’s party tonight. Now there’s a giant tongue mark right in the middle. Mom is going to be so mad when she gets home. We're definitely in big trouble. Seriously, big trouble. Bad dog, Buster!

After school, I ran to my room to play Roblox with my best friend Sam. We played a game called "Adopt Me" where you get cool pets. I traded a rare cat for a dragon! Then my mom yelled, "Dinner time!" so I had to stop. Later, we watched Pokemon on TV. Ash was trying to catch a new Pokemon in the forest. It was super exciting. I wish I had a Pikachu in real life. Tomorrow, I want to play Minecraft and build a huge castle made of diamond blocks.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It had lots of butter on it. Then I went to school on the big yellow bus. We learned about frogs in science class. Frogs are green and jump high. At recess, I played tag with my best friend. I ran very fast and no one could catch me. When I got home, I did my homework and played with my dog. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I hope tomorrow is fun too.

I couldn’t believe my eyes. No way! My dog Buster was actually sitting at the kitchen table. He was wearing Dad’s glasses! "Oh man," I whispered. "You're in big trouble, Buster." He just looked at me and barked. It’s weird, but I think he wanted some cereal. Suddenly, Mom walked in. "What on earth?" she yelled. We’re definitely not supposed to let Buster on the chairs. I grabbed a piece of toast and ran outside. Close call! Next time, I hope Buster learns to hide better.

Today was a very good day. First, I woke up and ate toast for breakfast. It had lots of jam on it. Then I went to school on the big yellow bus. We played tag at recess and I ran very fast. My friend Sam fell down, but he was okay. After school, I did my homework. Math is hard, but reading is fun. For dinner, we had pizza with cheese. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I hope tomorrow is fun too.

I can't believe we're finally going to the water park today! It's been raining all week, but now the sun is super bright. Wow! My brother said he's going on the big slide first, but I don't think he will because he's actually scared of heights. No way! I'm definitely going on the lazy river though. It's the best part. Mom packed us giant sandwiches for lunch, and Dad said we can get ice cream later if we're good. Oh man! I hope we don't have to leave early. Best day ever!

Oh man! I can't believe it's finally Saturday. We're going to the park today, and my brother said he’ll bring his new soccer ball. The shiny red one. I really hope we don't have to leave early like last time. It’s not fair when Mom says we have chores to do. Ugh. But guess what? Dad promised we could get ice cream after! Wow! Chocolate chip is definitely the best flavor. I’m going to run so fast today. No way anyone can catch me!

Today was a really good day. I woke up early and ate toast with jam for breakfast. It was very yummy. Then I went to school on the bus. We played tag at recess and I ran very fast. My friend Sam was "it" two times. After school, I came home and played with my dog, Buster. He likes to chase his red ball. Now I am tired. I will eat dinner soon and then go to sleep. I hope tomorrow is fun too.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast with jam for breakfast. It was yummy. Then I went to the park with my dad. We played catch with a red ball. The sun was hot and bright. I saw a big dog running fast. After that, we went home for lunch. We had pizza and apple juice. In the afternoon, I drew a picture of a blue car. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I hope tomorrow is fun too.

I can't believe it! We found a secret door in my attic today. No way! It was hidden behind a giant stack of old boxes. My best friend Sam said we shouldn't open it, but I just had to look. Oh man! It was so dusty. When I turned the handle, it made a super loud creak. We're going to explore it tomorrow after school. I hope there's treasure inside or maybe a ghost. Wow! It's going to be the best adventure ever. I promise to tell you everything later.

Today was a good day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It was very yummy. Then I went to school on the big yellow bus. I sat with my best friend named Sam. We played tag at recess and I ran very fast. After school, I did my homework. Math is hard but I finished it. Now I am going to watch TV and eat dinner with my mom and dad. I hope we have pizza. I am sleepy now. Goodnight!

I love Saturdays because my mom lets me play video games for two hours. My favorite game is Minecraft. I am building a huge castle made of diamonds and gold blocks. Sometimes my brother helps me, but mostly he just wants to play Fortnite with his friends. After lunch, we usually watch Pokemon on the big TV. Pikachu is the best because he is electric. Next week, my dad promised to buy me the new Spider-Man game if I clean my room every day. I really hope I can get it!

Yesterday, my friend Leo came over to my house. We wanted to play Fortnite, but my mom said no because it is too loud. So we played Roblox instead. We made a huge castle in the game, but then Leo fell into the lava. "Oh no!" he yelled. "Help me!" I tried to save him, but I fell in too. It was so funny. After that, we watched Pokemon on TV and ate popcorn. Pikachu is my favorite because he is yellow and super strong. I hope Leo comes back tomorrow.

My big sister acted like a brave **knight** in our game today. We pretended my bed was a secret **island** in the middle of the ocean. "Help me!" I yelled when the lava monster came. She ran **straight** at the monster with her pillow sword and saved me just in time. We played for a long time until mom called us for dinner. "That was **enough** playing," mom said. I **thought** it was the best game ever.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast with jam for breakfast. It was yummy. Then I went to the park with my dad. We played catch with a red ball. The sun was hot and bright. After that, we saw a big dog running fast on the grass. The dog was happy. When we came home, I ate a cheese sandwich. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I hope tomorrow is fun too.

Yesterday my mom said I could play video games for one hour because I finished my homework early. I turned on my Nintendo Switch and started playing Minecraft with my best friend Leo. We built a huge castle made of stone and put lava all around it to stop the zombies. Then we switched to Roblox to play a game where you have to run away from a giant piggy. It was so scary but funny too. After that, we watched a new episode of Pokémon on TV. Pikachu is my favorite because he is super strong.

I can’t believe we’re finally going to the water park! It’s been forever since Mom promised. My brother Max is jumping on his bed like a crazy monkey. "Stop it, Max!" I yelled, but he won't listen. Oh man! He just knocked over his lamp. Crash! Mom came running in and she looked super mad. No way! Now we have to clean up the mess before we can leave. It’s so unfair. I hope we don't miss the big wave pool. Hurry up, Max!

Yesterday after school, my friend Leo came over to play. We turned on the TV and started playing Minecraft first. I built a huge castle with lava all around it, but Leo accidentally blew it up with TNT! He said, "Sorry!" so we switched games. We played Roblox next and did a really hard obstacle course. It took forever to jump over the red blocks. Then my mom said we had to stop because dinner was ready. We watched a little bit of Pokemon while we ate pizza. It was the best afternoon ever.

My favorite thing to do on Saturdays is play Roblox with my best friend, Leo. We usually play a game called Adopt Me where you get to take care of cool pets. Last week, I finally got a neon dragon! Leo was so jealous. Then my mom said, "Turn off the screen, it's time for lunch!" After we ate sandwiches, we watched Pokemon on TV. Ash Ketchum is super cool, but I like Pikachu the best because he is yellow and shoots lightning. I wish I had a real Pikachu.

My big sister acted like a brave knight in our game. We pretended the backyard was a scary island with lava everywhere. "Watch out!" she yelled. She ran straight towards the swings but almost fell. Then she caught a ball I threw and saved the day. I thought we were done, but she said, "That’s not enough playing!" So we ran through the sprinkler until mom called us for dinner. It was the best day ever.

My favorite thing to do after school is play Roblox with my best friend Sam. We usually play a game called Adopt Me because we like collecting the rare pets. Yesterday, I finally got a neon dragon! Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It had lots of butter on it. Then I went to the park with my dad. We played catch with a red ball. The sun was hot and bright. I can't believe we actually found it! The secret treehouse. It’s huge! My brother said it wasn't real, but he’s totally wrong. We pushed through the prickly bushes and boom, there it was. Oh man! It has a rope ladder and everything. "Don't touch anything yet," I whispered, but my friend Sam was already climbing up. No way! I scrambled up right behind him. We're going to make this our new base for sure. Best Saturday ever! Now we just need some snacks. Maybe cookies. Definitely cookies.

Yesterday after school, my friend Sam came over to play. We turned on the TV and started playing Minecraft. I built a huge castle out of blue blocks, but Sam spawned a bunch of zombies inside it! "Hey, stop that!" I yelled. He just laughed. Then we switched to playing Roblox because I wanted to play the pizza game. It was super funny when my character fell into the oven. After that, we watched a new Spider-Man cartoon while eating popcorn. It was the best afternoon ever because we beat the boss level.

I love playing Minecraft on the weekends. My sister and I built a huge castle with a secret room full of diamonds. "Look out for the creeper!" she yelled, but it was too late and the wall blew up. We laughed so hard. After that, we switched to Roblox to play a game called Adopt Me. I got a legendary pet dragon. Then my mom said, "Turn off the TV, it is time for dinner." I hope I can play Fortnite tomorrow with my best friend Sam. We want to get a victory royale.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It was yummy. Then I went to the park with my dad. We saw a big dog running fast. I played on the swings for a long time. I went very high! After that, we went home for lunch. We had pizza with extra cheese. I love pizza so much. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I hope tomorrow is fun too. Goodnight!

I really didn't want to clean my room today. It’s totally unfair! Just because Mom stepped on one tiny Lego, now I have to pick up everything. "Hurry up!" she yelled from the kitchen. Oh man. I shoved all my clothes under the bed. The closet too. It looked okay, I guess. Then my dog Buster ran in and grabbed a sock. "No way, Buster!" I chased him, but he was too fast. Crash! He knocked over my lamp. We're definitely in trouble now. Big trouble.

It’s super hot outside today, so we can’t play soccer. Oh man! I really wanted to practice my kicks. But my mom said we’re going to the pool instead. Wow! That’s way better. I grabbed my towel and my goggles as fast as I could. I hope the diving board is open. My brother says he’s going to do a cannonball, but I don’t believe him. No way! He’s too scared of heights. We’re leaving in five minutes. Best day ever!

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It had strawberry jam on it. Then I went to school on the big yellow bus. We played kickball at recess, and my team won the game. I kicked the ball really far! After school, I helped my mom make cookies. They were chocolate chip cookies. They tasted so yummy. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I hope tomorrow is fun too. Goodnight!

I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw the huge box in the living room. It was taller than me! My brother shouted, "No way! Is that for us?" We ran over and touched the cardboard. It felt warm. Suddenly, something scratched the inside. Scratch, scratch. Oh man! We jumped back fast. "It's alive!" I whispered. Mom just laughed and handed us some scissors. We’re going to open it right now. I hope it’s a puppy. Or maybe a robot. Wow! This is the best day ever.

Yesterday, my friend Sam came over to play video games. First, we played Minecraft and built a giant castle made of gold blocks. Sam wanted to put lava everywhere, but I said, "No way! It will burn our house down." Then we switched to Roblox and played a game where we had to run away from a scary piggy. It was so funny when Sam got caught. Later, we watched a new Pokemon show while we ate pizza. I wish I had a Pikachu in real life because he is super cool.

My dad told me a story about a brave **knight** who lived on a tiny **island**. The knight **thought** he saw a dragon, so he ran **straight** into the dark woods to find it. But he only **caught** a little green frog instead! The frog jumped right **through** his shiny helmet. "That is **enough** adventure for today," the knight said. He went home to tell his **daughter** all about the scary frog. She just laughed at him because frogs aren't scary at all.
